chapter: Chicago memories and the road to the Navy
title: Jazz slang: bring down, drag, swing them into bad health
summary: Marge and Dance trade slang such as bring down, drag and swinging them into bad health, and Paul Gonsalves objecting to calling someone a drag.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: A lot of people can't remember the 'bring down.' You know, like you know you was having to explain it to old Bert the other day what 'bring down' means. Instead of a drag, you used to say 'bring down'.
Yes, I know that. That was current in '37 when I came.
But Billie Holiday she used that 'drag.' Man this band is dragging me all over the place.
Well I said to Phil (Gonsalves?) one night, I was talking, no I won't say what I was talking about,
but I said, 'well he's a drag.' And Paul said, don't use slang expressions like that around me Stanley.
